module: Node "Freeze Vehicle" (category `repeat_instant`). Freezes or unfreezes a vehicle via `core_vehicleBridge.executeAction(veh,'setFreeze', freeze)`. Input pins: `vehId`, `freeze` (bool). If `vehId` is absent, player vehicle.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Sends the `setFreeze` action with the value of the `freeze` pin.
